  • [UK NEWS] Prince Phillip had passed, what's happens now? - Rezon ®
    The Duke of Edinburgh, Prince Philip, passed away peacefully on the morning of April 9, 2021. Following his death, tributes and condolences were shared by leaders and individuals around the world, and news stations interrupted their regular programming to share a series of special programs.

  • BLM Founder Buys 1.4 Million Dollar Home Around 'WHITE PEOPLE' - Heisenberg
    One of the co-founders of the Black Lives Matter organization has purchased a house worth roughly $1.4 million. Do you think the house was purchased with money made through fundraising? Check out Heisenberg's thread and leave your thoughts about this.

  • What do you do late at night when you cant sleep - Prison
    Plenty of people struggle with getting to sleep at night. In fact, it is somewhat normal. Do you have ways of dealing with restlessness, or do you get up and work on a project?

Kraken Plans to go Public
Following in Coinbase's footsteps, Kraken has confirmed its plans to go public. Coinbase announced in early 2021 that they intended to list on the stock exchange under the ticker COIN. The CEO of Kraken, a competing cryptocurrency exchange, revealed in an interview that the company is "looking at being able to go public sometime next year," with next year being 2022. Powell also stated that Kraken has been delaying seeking new investors so that they can "see where the Coinbase valuation comes in at." Should Coinbase receive a multi-billion dollar valuation through their public listing, it will indicate to Kraken that they could run a new funding round to increase their valuation to reach similar levels. >>Source


Saudi Arabia's Manga Productions, Toei to Open The Journey Film in Japan on June 25
The Journey (Journey: Taiko Arabia Hantо̄ de no Kiseki to Tatakai no Monogatari, or Journey: A Tale of Miracles and Battles on the Ancient Arabian Peninsula) anime will premiere in Japan on June 25. This was revealed by the new official website that opened on Thursday for Saudi Arabian media company Manga Productions and Toei Animation. >>Source

Penguidrum Crowdfunding Campaign Meets Goal in 3 Minutes
The crowdfunding campaign for Re:cycle of Penguindrum started on Thursday on the Ubugoe website, and it met its goal of 10 million yen (about $90,000) in less than three minutes. The crowdfunding was started to support Re:cycle of Penguindrum compilation film project, commemorating the 10th anniversary of director Kunihiko Ikuhara's Mawaru Penguindrum anime. The project currently funded 51,310,504 yen (about $468,000), which is 513% of its goal. The campaign will last till May 28. >>Source

'Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro' Anime Casts Nana Mizuki
Nana Mizuki will voice the President of the art club in the anime Don't Toy with Me, Miss Nagatoro (Ijiranaide, Nagatoro-san). The official website announced this for the anime. The character is a third-year high school student who excels academically and physically. The anime premiered on the Tokyo MX and BS11 channels on April 10. >>Source
